title: pm daily scratchpad - 2026-03-14
content:
Morning quick log - 2026-03-14

Top objectives for today:
- Finish PRD edits for "Hosted API: rollout and fallback policy" (section: Smart routing + fallback). Need clear language for dedicated/private fallback semantics.
- Sync with SRE on canary traffic plan and latency SLO for model fallback. Confirm abort conditions.
- Finalize launch checklist items and assign owners (docs, console, QA, infra).

Notes from standup:
- Priya: working on console dashboard UI for per-route tracing. Wants final metrics list by EOD.
- Ethan: load testing infra ok, will run canary with 10k RPS next Tue. Needs list of endpoints and payload shapes.
- UX: Sarah will deliver copy for the new error states by 3/16.

PRD edits TODO (in-document markers):
- [ ] Clarify fallback hierarchy: primary hosted -> region fallback -> model-variant fallback -> dedicated reserved pool. Add diagram (placeholder).
- [ ] Add explicit SLO breach rollback steps and who executes (SRE oncall + product oncall).
- [x] Update rollout cadence (canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) -- done.
- [ ] Add scale-up threshold numbers for Dedicated bursts. Need input from infra (ask Kevin).

Stakeholder follow-ups:
- Ping Kevin (infra) for Dedicated burst thresholds and autoscaler tolerances.
- Remind legal to confirm data retention wording for Private deployments (pending compliance review).
- Schedule 30m with CS (Monica) to review support playbook for model fallback incidents.

Launch checklist (working):
- Product
  - [ ] PRD final sign-off (PM + Eng + SRE + Legal)
  - [ ] Release notes draft (owner: me)
- Engineering
  - [ ] Canary routing policy implemented (owner: eng-routing)
  - [ ] Automated rollback on error rate threshold (owner: sre)
  - [ ] QA smoke tests for fallback correctness (owner: qa)
- Console/Docs
  - [ ] API docs updated for fallback semantics + examples (owner: docs-team)
  - [ ] Console rollout toggle + UI copy (owner: priya)
- Observability
  - [ ] Dashboards: per-route latency, fallback rate, token-cost delta (owner: observability)
  - [ ] Alerts: error-rate, increased tail latency, model-mismatch metric (owner: sre)
- Compliance/Security
  - [ ] KMS integration verification for Private (owner: security)
  - [ ] Audit log retention confirmed (owner: legal)

Risks / blockers:
- No final numbers from infra on Dedicated burst capacity -> blocks PRD quantification and cost estimates.
- UX copy for error states delayed -> could hold console merge if not mocked.
- Legal still reviewing data residency paragraph (ask legal for fastest path).

Quick wins / low-effort items to unblock:
- Put placeholder diagram in PRD (simple ASCII or PNG) so design can iterate separately.
- Create a small test harness with known payload shapes for Ethan to run initial canary flows.

Meeting notes (12:00 sync with SRE):
- Agreed: canary traffic plan will start at 2% and run for 2 hours with health checks (p50/p95 latency + error rate). If error_rate > 1% or p95 > baseline + 200ms, abort and rollback.
- Action: SRE to provide rollback runbook and automation by 3/15.

Draft of message to stakeholders (to send after PRD update):
Hey all — quick update on Hosted API rollout: main PRD edits pushed (smart routing/fallback sections). SRE and infra are finalizing canary thresholds; QA to run smoke tests next week. I will circulate the final checklist once Kevin confirms Dedicated burst numbers. Please review the PRD link and leave comments by EOD Fri.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we treat model-variant fallback as best-effort with no SLA, or do we guarantee a degraded SLA? (Prefer to call it "best-effort" but need legal/comms alignment)
- What is the minimum Dedicated burst reserved to expose burst behavior to customers? (Input from infra)

Next actions for today:
- 9:30 - finish PRD fallback section + add diagram placeholder (me)
- 11:00 - follow up with Kevin (infra) about burst numbers (Priya to join)
- 12:00 - SRE sync (meeting)
- 14:00 - update release notes draft and put in shared folder
- 16:00 - backlog grooming (remove outdated tickets, label "launch-blocker")

Notes to self:
- Keep language conservative for external-facing docs (avoid promising firm SLAs for fallback).
- Capture one example customer story for README: "how app keeps serving during model failover".

End of day quick check:
- Did we get numbers from infra? ___
- PRD comments resolved? ___
- QA smoke tests scheduled? ___
summary_notes: PM scratchpad covering PRD edits, canary/rollback plan, launch checklist, stakeholders and blockers.
